item.title: Fire Chief Considerations: Using E-Bikes in Emergency Response
item.description: While the use of e-bikes in the delivery of fire and EMS services is not going to replace traditional apparatus response, there are many scenarios in which e-bikes can be great resources for fire departments throughout North America. The post Fire Chief Considerations: Using E-Bikes in Emergency Response appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Three Tractor-Trailers Crash in Same Icy Spot, Damaging Fire, Police Vehicles
item.description: A tractor-trailer T-boned a Perry Area (MI) Fire Department apparatus that was blocking the freeway. The semi had slowed sufficiently before impact, resulting in only minor damage to the rig. One firefighter suffered minor injuries. The post Three Tractor-Trailers Crash in Same Icy Spot, Damaging Fire, Police Vehicles appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.
